From: Sarah Cho <sarah.cho@acme-industries.com>
To: ava_chen@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sealed-site activation coordination

Hi Ava,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. We're lining up the physical transfer of the signed image bundle to the sealed site in Tulsa next week and need Redwood's preflight checklist and a proposed signer schedule (name + 30-min window) for the operator acceptance ceremony. The customer also asked for the emergency revocation point-of-contact and the precise revocation timeline if an image needs to be rolled back after activation.

High level asks:  
- Preflight checklist we can run against the on-site environment (network gates, airlock handoff, operator credentials)
- Recommended signer windows and who must be present (Redwood, on-site operator, courier)
- Revocation procedure and expected RTO for a revocation request

Can you share the checklist and a short runbook? We need to get these into Acme's change window request by EOD Wednesday.

Appreciate it —
Sarah

Sarah Cho
Infrastructure Delivery Manager
Acme Industrial Systems
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Cho <sarah.cho@acme-industries.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sealed-site activation coordination

Sarah — thanks, attaching our initial preflight checklist and a short FAQ. See attachment: preflight_checklist_v0.3.pdf.

Quick answers up front:
- Signer windows: 30-minute activation windows are fine; we recommend a primary signer + secondary (backup) from Redwood on-call for the 30-min window, and a 15-min overlap for courier/operator handoff.
- Revocation: emergency revocation can be requested by the customer's Site Security Lead or by Redwood Security. Once a revocation request is authorized, the fastest achievable RTO is ~45 minutes for token revocation + 2 hours for cluster rollback (depends on site connectivity and operator availability). We will document a strict escalation path.

Marissa / Jonas — looping you in to confirm the signer schedule and to provide the signed-manifest workflow and the revocation slug we will hand to the site. Sarah, we'll get a signed-manifest stub back to you within 8 business hours once we align internal signatures.

Attachments: preflight_checklist_v0.3.pdf (attachment, 48 KB)

Thanks,
Ava
Ava Chen
Director, Private Deployments 
Redwood Inference

Hi Sarah / Ava,

Appreciate the urgency. We're good to proceed on the proposed timeline. Deliverables attached: signed_manifest_v1.json and a short revocation_policy.pdf that summarizes the emergency process. Highlights below:

- Signer schedule: 
  * Primary: Marissa Cole (marissa_cole@redwood.ai) — activation window Thu 2027-04-22 09:30–10:00 CST
  * Secondary (backup): Jonas Weber (jonas_weber@redwood.ai) — backup window 09:45–10:15 CST
  * Operator handoff: Acme Site Operator 

- Activation checklist: follow preflight_checklist_v0.3.pdf (network gate closed, operator creds verified, courier handoff documented). We'll run a remote verification call 15 minutes before the physical activation.

- Emergency revocation:
  * Authorization: Site Security Lead (Acme) OR Redwood Security (listed below) can initiate.
  * Steps: 1) Issue revocation token (Redwood Security) -> 2) Agent stop + KV cache flush -> 3) Model variant rollback/disable -> 4) Postmortem and revert patch.
  * Expected timings: token revoke in 5–30 min (most cases <15), full rollback target 120 min.
  * Emergency contacts: Redwood Security Ops Pager + Security Slack channel (redwood-security-ops).

Attached: signed_manifest_v1.json (attachment, 12 KB), revocation_policy.pdf (attachment, 24 KB)

Please confirm receipt and if you want the remote verification call scheduled for Thu 09:15 CST.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
